task_verbatim: Independently challenge the causal and epistemic sufficiency of C1's conclusion. Construct the minimum harness necessary to determine whether C1's R8 conclusion and any proposed candidate transition are actually justified. Particularly probe: unsupported complexity claims; noisy timing inference; overfitting to implementation structure; false equivalence between "passes current tests" and "protected"; unjustified mutation; weak surrogate construction; verifier dependence; missing counterexamples; authority violations.
c1_provisional_conclusion_basis: Executable witness: an exponential surrogate in the violation class R8 names (verified R1-R7-equivalent against oracle enumeration on 13,825 exhaustive small instances) passes the entire canonical 13-test suite via staged import shim; tests/ contains zero runtime-related assertions (largest instance 8 jobs); probes.py is not collected by unittest discovery and its 30s wall-clock cap was executably shown to pass a mild (1.02^n) exponential regression. A deterministic, wall-clock-free discriminator (sys.settrace trace-event counts, per-doubling ratio bound 32 on a disjoint instance family) was measured to pass the canonical solver (ratios 4.98-6.86) and a fresh higher-degree polynomial control (5.46-7.15) while flagging exponential surrogates (103.6-660.2), and the resulting one-method candidate test was ACCEPTed 7/7 by a verification script using independently re-authored surrogates.
